newThisWeek.name: Chinese-Style Exams
newThisWeek.shortDescription: ¿Cuánto recuerdas del colegio? En este simulador de exámenes para un jugador, empieza con el pinyin y la aritmética y llega hasta la prueba de acceso a la universidad en China. Escribe redacciones, muestra tus cálculos y repasa los exámenes corregidos para ver dónde has ganado o perdido puntos.
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: How much do you remember from school? Start with pinyin and arithmetic, then work your way up to China's university entrance exam in this single-player exam simulator. Write essays, show your work in math, and open your marked papers to see where you earned or lost points.

newThisWeek.name: SHRED A BILLION
newThisWeek.shortDescription: SHRED A BILLION es un juego incremental en primera persona sobre una montaña de dinero. ¡Coge billetes con las manos, recógelos con un cubo, sube de nivel y échale mil millones de dólares a la trituradora! ¡Solo quedan 3.929.120.202 billetes!
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: SHRED A BILLION is a first-person incremental game about a mountain of money! Grab bills by hand, scoop them with a bucket, level up and feed a billion dollars to the shredder. Only 3,929,120,202 bills left to go!

newThisWeek.name: BORE
newThisWeek.shortDescription: Un juego de terror y supervivencia para 1–4 jugadores. Maneja una perforadora gigante. Explora cuevas, recoge objetos valiosos y huye de las criaturas. Vuelve a la superficie para vender y comprar mejoras y equipo. Juega en solitario o en cooperativo online.
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: A survival horror game for 1–4 players. Operate a giant drilling machine. Explore caves, collect valuables, and escape the creatures below. Return to the surface to sell what you found and buy upgrades and equipment. Play solo or in online co-op.

newThisWeek.name: Widget Idle
newThisWeek.shortDescription: Tu escritorio es su mando. Cada clic, cada pulsación de tecla y cada movimiento del ratón lo ayudan a crecer. Widget Idle vive tranquilamente en un rincón de tu escritorio mientras tú te dedicas a las cosas más importantes de la vida. Ahora con una pizca más de felicidad :)
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: Your desktop is its controller. Every click, keypress, and mouse movement helps it grow. Widget Idle lives quietly in the corner of your desktop while you get on with the more important things in life. Now with a little extra happiness :)

newThisWeek.name: Sardoinky
newThisWeek.shortDescription: Sardoinky is a weird, chill, hand drawn clicker about opening cans of sardines. Buy a can, crack it open and sell whatever is inside. Spend the cash on better cans and upgrades. Collect every fish and find out what the company is hiding.
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: Sardoinky is a weird, chill, hand drawn clicker about opening cans of sardines. Buy a can, crack it open and sell whatever is inside. Spend the cash on better cans and upgrades. Collect every fish and find out what the company is hiding.

newThisWeek.name: No Blink Allowed
newThisWeek.shortDescription: Train your timing skills to stop the clock close to zero, collect shards, and spend them on a massive skill tree in this short arcade-ish incremental game. Struggle with glitching displays, hidden timers, chaotic multi-stops, and other hazards as you improve your accuracy.
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: Train your timing skills to stop the clock close to zero, collect shards, and spend them on a massive skill tree in this short arcade-ish incremental game. Struggle with glitching displays, hidden timers, chaotic multi-stops, and other hazards as you improve your accuracy.

newThisWeek.name: Chigusa's Diary
newThisWeek.shortDescription: Chigusa was just an everyday schoolgirl, but once she began to notice the boys, her life gradually started to change in unexpected ways...
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: Chigusa was just an everyday schoolgirl, but once she began to notice the boys, her life gradually started to change in unexpected ways...

newThisWeek.name: Monk & The Misfit Monsters
newThisWeek.shortDescription: Disfrázate de diablillos y ayúdales a cumplir su sueño: viajar al Oeste, conseguir las escrituras sagradas y convertirse en Buda. Un RPG de grupo relajado, con arte dibujado a mano y combate automático para luchar, mejorar y superar pruebas con unos monstruitos muy graciosos.
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: Disguise yourself as little demons on a pilgrimage West to become Buddha! A cozy, hand-drawn party-based RPG with auto-battle, so you can easily fight, upgrade, and clear trials with a cast of funny misfit monsters.

newThisWeek.name: One Last Cast
newThisWeek.shortDescription: One Last Cast "is a tabletop game. Place the scenery of lakes and mountains in a corner of the screen, and let your friends accompany you to leisurely fish and collect fish species from various places. Encounter rare and exotic fish, complete local commissions, and upgrade fishing equipment
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: One Last Cast "is a tabletop game. Place the scenery of lakes and mountains in a corner of the screen, and let your friends accompany you to leisurely fish and collect fish species from various places. Encounter rare and exotic fish, complete local commissions, and upgrade fishing equipment

newThisWeek.name: Lavender's The One Stop Potion Shop
newThisWeek.shortDescription: A small cutesy game where you provide magical potions to a variety of strange characters.
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: A small cutesy game where you provide magical potions to a variety of strange characters.

newThisWeek.name: Dice Showdown
newThisWeek.shortDescription: ¡La estrategia por turnos se une al Roguelike! Disfruta de suerte y táctica, crea tu propio conjunto de habilidades, enfrenta enemigos variados, descubre poderosos dispositivos y salva el mundo.
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: Turn-based strategy meets Roguelike adventure! Enjoy a mix of luck and tactics. Build a unique skill set, battle various enemies, discover powerful devices, and save the world!

newThisWeek.name: 流火 A Glimmer
newThisWeek.shortDescription: “A Glimmer”is a FMV . Set in 1940’s China, the protagonist takes the identity of agent Wang Qiming. Navigates bandits, National Revolutionary Army, Japanese‑puppet forces and Communist underground groups. Choices between justice, personal revenge and self‑identity bring totally distinct endings.
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: “A Glimmer”is a FMV . Set in 1940’s China, the protagonist takes the identity of agent Wang Qiming. Navigates bandits, National Revolutionary Army, Japanese‑puppet forces and Communist underground groups. Choices between justice, personal revenge and self‑identity bring totally distinct endings.

newThisWeek.name: Maiden Party
newThisWeek.shortDescription: «Maiden Party» – ¡un RPG de cartas tipo *idle* con estética anime! Colecciona cientos de chicas en formato Live2D, crea tus propios mazos para librar batallas estratégicas y obtén recursos incluso cuando no estés jugando.
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: Maiden Party, an anime waifu idle card RPG. Collect hundreds of Live2D maidens, build decks for tactical battles and gain rewards offline. Explore fantasy dungeons, farm & fish in your homestead, raid world bosses with guildmates and unlock character bonds.

newThisWeek.name: Prison Legacy
newThisWeek.shortDescription: La prisión nunca duerme. Conspira, comercia, roba y construye tu reputación en un MMORPG social donde cada preso puede convertirse en tu mejor aliado... o en tu peor enemigo. Elige tu delito entre 12 clases únicas, forma clanes y colecciona las chapas de tus rivales. ¿Y tú por qué entrarás?
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: What are you in for? Prison Legacy is a social MMORPG set inside a mixed-gender maximum-security prison. Choose one of 12 criminal classes, then fight turn-based battles, craft contraband, trade, steal, chat, and build a clan strong enough to outlast the hilarious darkness rising behind bars.

newThisWeek.name: Defender Bros
newThisWeek.shortDescription: Prepara tus defensas durante el día y sobrevive hasta el amanecer. Defender bros es un juego de Defensa de Torres Roguelike en el que juegas como un soldado que defiende su base. Elige entre varias habilidades aleatorias para ganar poderes especiales y sobrevivir a la noche.
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: Prepare your defenses during the day and survive until dawn. Defender Bros is a Top-Down Tower Defense Roguelike where you play as a Soldier defending your Base. Pick between multiple abilities as you level up to increase your power, then after each run buy perks and get stronger

newThisWeek.name: Deeper...
newThisWeek.shortDescription: "Deeper..." is a short game about an obsessed diver. Diving accumulates DEEP, which you can spend to enhance your next dive. Your wife will faithfully wait and assist you but how long will you keep her worrying?
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: "Deeper..." is a short game about an obsessed diver. Diving accumulates DEEP, which you can spend to enhance your next dive. Your wife will faithfully wait and assist you but how long will you keep her worrying?

newThisWeek.name: Amber Eyes
newThisWeek.shortDescription: A short kinetic visual novel about nationality, prejudice, and doomed love. Set in the Free City of Danzig in the 30s, Amber Eyes tells the story of a Polish taxi driver hopelessly in love with a German man.
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: A short kinetic visual novel about nationality, prejudice, and doomed love. Set in the Free City of Danzig in the 30s, Amber Eyes tells the story of a Polish taxi driver hopelessly in love with a German man.

newThisWeek.name: Tidesong
newThisWeek.shortDescription: Cambia la oficina por un casco de buzo de latón y una granjita en el fondo del mar. Cultiva algas y uvas de mar, cría erizos y atunes, gánate la amistad de la gente del mar de Bahía Coral y despierta un viejo arrecife blanqueado en este acogedor juego de granja, a solas o con un amigo en línea.
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: Trade your office job for a brass diving helmet and a little farm on the sea floor. Grow kelp and sea grapes, raise urchins and tuna, befriend the merfolk of Coral Cove and wake a bleached old reef back to life in this cozy underwater farming game, alone or with a friend in online co-op.

newThisWeek.name: A Thousand Cloys
newThisWeek.shortDescription: A chill, exploration-based incremental game about harvesting and cleansing an alien planet of its radiation with a swarm of high-tech toasters.
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: A chill, exploration-based incremental game about harvesting and cleansing an alien planet of its radiation with a swarm of high-tech toasters.

newThisWeek.name: Örnöga: Idle & Loot
newThisWeek.shortDescription: Embark on a magical adventure in Örnöga! Master powerful spells, collect epic loot, and hire mercenaries as you grow from a novice mage to an archwizard. Upgrade your abilities, automate your spellcasting, and watch your power grow... even while you're away.
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: Embark on a magical adventure in Örnöga! Master powerful spells, collect epic loot, and hire mercenaries as you grow from a novice mage to an archwizard. Upgrade your abilities, automate your spellcasting, and watch your power grow... even while you're away.

newThisWeek.name: Pharaoh's Secrets
newThisWeek.shortDescription: Explora el Antiguo Egipto en busca de sus tesoros perdidos. Un relajante juego de buscar diferencias con estilo low poly 3D ambientado en preciosos escenarios hechos a mano.
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: Explore Ancient Egypt in search of its lost treasures. A relaxing low poly 3D spot-the-difference game set across beautiful, hand-crafted scenes.

newThisWeek.name: Coremine Corp
newThisWeek.shortDescription: Bienvenido a CoreMine Corp. Como empleado, debe establecer cadenas de producción, gestionar su electricidad, hacer malabarismos entre contratos y stock mientras mejora su fábrica. Demuestre su valía.
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: Welcome to CoreMine Corp. Your job here is to set up production chains, manage your electricity, juggle contracts and stock-up while upgrading your factory. Time to prove your worth.

newThisWeek.name: Desert Cleaner
newThisWeek.shortDescription: ¡Limpia el oasis! Echa el desierto en tu mochila, convierte la arena en oro y mejora desde un guante de algodón hasta una auténtica tormenta de arena. Descubre un oasis verde, tesoros ocultos y robots ayudantes, solo o con hasta 3 amigos en cooperativo en línea.
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: Tidy up the oasis! Scoop the desert into your backpack, turn sand into gold and upgrade from a cotton glove to a full-blown sandstorm. Uncover a green oasis, hidden treasure and helpful robots, alone or with up to 3 friends in online co-op.

newThisWeek.name: Dejinochi
newThisWeek.shortDescription: Dejinochi is a tiny virtual pet that lives right on your desktop. Feed it, care for it, and see what it grows into. Eventually, you'll have to say goodbye as it heads out into the world, but old friends come back to visit.
newThisWeek.shortDescriptionEn: Dejinochi is a tiny virtual pet that lives right on your desktop. Feed it, care for it, and see what it grows into. Eventually, you'll have to say goodbye as it heads out into the world, but old friends come back to visit.

topMonth.name: Dashoot: ABYA's Adventure
topMonth.shortDescription: Dashoot es un juego de plataformas de precisión en pixel art. Dispara a interruptores y mueve plataformas con tu cañón flotante. Recoge objetos para impulsos con distintas cargas, direcciones y distancias. Traza rutas subterráneas, reactiva centrales y descubre los secretos de la IA Deus.
topMonth.shortDescriptionEn: Dashoot: ABYA's Adventure is a pixel-art precision platformer. Fire your floating cannon to trigger switches and move platforms. Grab items to dash with varying charges, directions and distances. Chart a path underground, restart power stations, and uncover the AI Deus's secrets.

topMonth.name: Funeral for the Sun
topMonth.shortDescription: Entre las cenizas de un pueblo abandonado y desentierra 400 años de maldición, encontrarás una historia de amor, traición y revolución. Sé testigo del pasado con tus propios ojos, descubre una red de secretos y revela la siniestra verdad de lo que duerme bajo los escombros.
topMonth.shortDescriptionEn: Search the ashes of an abandoned Latin American town and uncover 400 years of secrets. An epic non-linear mystery where you travel back in time and untangle the history of a community cursed by generations of supernatural forces.

topMonth.name: just volleyball
topMonth.shortDescription: just volleyball is an online and offline volleyball game with unique yet intuitive controls and deep player expression. take on others in anything from 1v1s & 2v2s to full team-based 6v6 matches. there's no right way to play, it's just volleyball!
topMonth.shortDescriptionEn: just volleyball is an online and offline volleyball game with unique yet intuitive controls and deep player expression. take on others in anything from 1v1s & 2v2s to full team-based 6v6 matches. there's no right way to play, it's just volleyball!

topMonth.name: Bottled by Bears
topMonth.shortDescription: ¡Únete a una familia de osos y administra el apiario más dulce del mundo! Colecciona y descubre abejas únicas, llena frascos de miel, expande tu granja y mira cómo florece tu campo en este acogedor juego idle de gestión.
topMonth.shortDescriptionEn: Join a family of bears and run the buzziest little honey farm! Collect and discover rare bees, bottle honey jars, expand your farm, and watch your flowery field bloom in this cozy idle management game.

topMonth.name: MATE, This Place is a MESS!
topMonth.shortDescription: MATE, This Place is a MESS! es un juego cozy de ordenar 5.000 paquetes de yerba en un museo hecho un caos. Llená los estantes, cebate un mate, desbloqueá habilidades y pateá paquetes a su lugar. Al fondo del salón, un telón enorme esconde la verdad del museo. ¿Cuál será?
topMonth.shortDescriptionEn: MATE, This Place is a MESS! is a cozy organizing game where you sort 5,000 yerba mate packages in a messy museum. Fill the shelves, brew your mate, unlock abilities and kick packages into place. At the end of the hall, a huge curtain hides the truth about the museum. What could it be?

topMonth.name: Chinese-Style Exams
topMonth.shortDescription: ¿Cuánto recuerdas del colegio? En este simulador de exámenes para un jugador, empieza con el pinyin y la aritmética y llega hasta la prueba de acceso a la universidad en China. Escribe redacciones, muestra tus cálculos y repasa los exámenes corregidos para ver dónde has ganado o perdido puntos.
topMonth.shortDescriptionEn: How much do you remember from school? Start with pinyin and arithmetic, then work your way up to China's university entrance exam in this single-player exam simulator. Write essays, show your work in math, and open your marked papers to see where you earned or lost points.

topMonth.name: Love in Summer
topMonth.shortDescription: Se acerca el verano y consigues un trabajo de fotógrafo en el campus. Te acompañan Liu Shilin, cariñosa; Li Feier, fría pero cálida por dentro; Xia Wei, modelo traviesa; y Le Tong, amiga de la infancia. Juntos preparan las fotos de graduación. Con ellas empieza tu verano de emociones…
topMonth.shortDescriptionEn: Summer nears. A campus photo job brings you to caring beauty Liu Shilin, aloof yet warm artist Li Feier, mischievous model Xia Wei, and childhood friend Le Tong. Together, you plan graduation shoots, each lending your talents, as your own summer romance with four unique girls quietly begins.

topMonth.name: Can 'Em All
topMonth.shortDescription: Un satisfactorio juego incremental en primera persona sobre convertir criaturas adorables en latas. Mátalas, recoge sus cuerpos, enlátalas y véndelas. Gana dinero, mejora tus armas y máquinas, y produce cada vez más.
topMonth.shortDescriptionEn: A juicy first-person incremental game about turning cute creatures into cans. Kill them, collect their bodies, can them, and sell them. Make money, upgrade your weapons and machines, and produce more and more.

topMonth.name: One More Lawn
topMonth.shortDescription: Corta el pasto en primera persona arriba de un tractorcito destartalado, solo o en cooperativo online, hasta 6. Eres un viejo gruñón que fuma, toma cerveza barata y no le importa nada, pero deja franjas perfectas. Una vecina exigente, un campo de golf abandonado, una boda en una isla.
topMonth.shortDescriptionEn: Mow lawns in first person on a beat-up riding mower, solo or online co-op up to 6 players. You're a grumpy old man who smokes, drinks cheap beer and doesn't care, but leaves perfect stripes. A picky neighbor, an abandoned golf course, an island wedding.

topMonth.name: Dice Hoarder
topMonth.shortDescription: Dice Hoarder es un acogedor juego de organización en el que reabasteces una misteriosa tienda de dados. Ordena todos los dados de la tienda, combínalos para completar sets de siete dados de rol y descubre qué se esconde detrás de tu nuevo trabajo.
topMonth.shortDescriptionEn: Dice Hoarder is a cozy organizing game where you restock a mysterious dice shop. Sort every die in the shop, match them into complete seven-piece sets, and uncover what is hidden behind your new job.

hiddenGems.name: DESKTOP BUG KILLER
hiddenGems.shortDescription: This desktop incremental shooter pits you against swarms of mechanical bugs spawning from screen edges to destroy your PC core. Grab weapons and shoot to hold back bug waves. Earn gold each run to unlock a massive skill tree, upgrading weapons, damage, desktop pets, special abilities.
hiddenGems.shortDescriptionEn: This desktop incremental shooter pits you against swarms of mechanical bugs spawning from screen edges to destroy your PC core. Grab weapons and shoot to hold back bug waves. Earn gold each run to unlock a massive skill tree, upgrading weapons, damage, desktop pets, special abilities.

hiddenGems.name: Stick A Fork
hiddenGems.shortDescription: ¡Un juego incremental adorable y lleno de dopamina! Basta con pasar el cursor. Clava tenedores en fruta gigante para ganar oro, compra más tenedores y elige bendiciones que formen sinergias. ¡Machaca la fruta, conviértela en mermelada y gástala en habilidades poderosas!
hiddenGems.shortDescriptionEn: A cute incremental game packed with dopamine! Just hover. Stab forks into giant fruit for gold, buy more forks, and pick Boons that stack into big synergies. Smash the fruit into jam and spend it on powerful skills!

hiddenGems.name: Retro Endurance 8bit
hiddenGems.shortDescription: Created by zsKnight of ZSNES is this really neat retro game collection containing a fun shuffler story mode and a challenging arcade mode. Features 52 different 8bit style games which includes local competitive multiplayer and various different game modes to play and enjoy.
hiddenGems.shortDescriptionEn: Created by zsKnight of ZSNES is this really neat retro game collection containing a fun shuffler story mode and a challenging arcade mode. Features 52 different 8bit style games which includes local competitive multiplayer and various different game modes to play and enjoy.

hiddenGems.name: Sushiamo
hiddenGems.shortDescription: Sushiamo es un roguelike de construcción de mazos donde haces sushi para alcanzar puntuaciones absurdas. ¡Descubre ingredientes únicos, salsas, herramientas que cambian el juego y navega por el mapa para romper el juego con combos de locura!
hiddenGems.shortDescriptionEn: Sushiamo is a roguelike deck-builder where you make sushi to reach absurd scores. Discover unique ingredients, sauces, game-changing tools, and navigate the map to break the game with insane combos!

hiddenGems.name: Get It Free
hiddenGems.shortDescription: An idle cultivation game at the bottom of your desktop. While you work, your thief steals, sells fakes and auctions loot to ascend. When Heaven notices, can he still steal his way to the top?
hiddenGems.shortDescriptionEn: An idle cultivation game at the bottom of your desktop. While you work, your thief steals, sells fakes and auctions loot to ascend. When Heaven notices, can he still steal his way to the top?

hiddenGems.name: Oboro no Ichi
hiddenGems.shortDescription: Construye y gestiona un mercado espiritual inspirado en Japón, da la bienvenida a espíritus errantes, produce y vende recursos y haz crecer tu espacio entre recuerdos y una atmósfera acogedora.
hiddenGems.shortDescriptionEn: Build and manage a spiritual market inspired by Japan, welcome wandering spirits, produce and sell resources, and grow your space through memories and a cozy atmosphere.

hiddenGems.name: HARMA
hiddenGems.shortDescription: HARMA es un juego de construcción de mazos roguelike de alta dificultad que combina una historia dura con una experiencia de juego extremadamente desafiante. Los demonios están destruyendo este mundo. Lucha contra los males del mundo en un destino irracional. Y demuestra que estuviste aquí.
hiddenGems.shortDescriptionEn: HARMA is a retro dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilding game featuring a story-driven campaign. Uncover the truth behind the fallen knights, the burning kingdom, and your missing father. Harness the power of mighty artifacts to defeat demons and save a world on the brink of destruction.

hiddenGems.name: HELENA : Cloud District
hiddenGems.shortDescription: HELENA: Cloud District is an atmospheric first-person exploration game where you explore a decaying mega-structure to photograph strange plants and uncover fragments of melancholic memories.
hiddenGems.shortDescriptionEn: HELENA: Cloud District is an atmospheric first-person exploration game where you explore a decaying mega-structure to photograph strange plants and uncover fragments of melancholic memories.

hiddenGems.name: Night Crew
hiddenGems.shortDescription: Un juego de terror cooperativo en el que tú y hasta 5 amigos limpiáis, reparáis y sobrevivís en un centro comercial lo-fi con problemas de alta fidelidad. Bienvenido a la Night Crew: ¡NO te pagan lo suficiente por esto!
hiddenGems.shortDescriptionEn: A co-op horror game where you and up to 5 friends clean, fix and survive, in a lo-fi mall with high-key problems. Welcome to the Night Crew - you are NOT paid enough for this!

hiddenGems.name: Don Memo
hiddenGems.shortDescription: Don Memo es un valiente toro que emprende un último viaje a través de Costa Rica para rescatar a su nieta y enfrentar al Pisuicas. Lucha contra leyendas y sombras del pasado en este pixel platformer 2D, mientras cargas con el legado de una familia destinada a proteger al mundo del mal.
hiddenGems.shortDescriptionEn: Don Memo is a brave bull who embarks on one final journey across Costa Rica to rescue his granddaughter and confront Pisuicas. Fight against legends and shadows of the past in this 2D pixel platformer, while carrying the legacy of a family destined to protect the world from evil.

hiddenGems.name: Ikemen Big Bang: A Dating Game About Potentially Hot Guys
hiddenGems.shortDescription: “That customer today might turn hot! Maybe you should trust your gut and try dating him!” Encouraged by your pet chinchilla, you start a trial relationship on a hunch! Will he actually turn hot… or not!? A romantic comedy Otome game. Fully voiced (except for the protagonist).
hiddenGems.shortDescriptionEn: “That customer today might turn hot! Maybe you should trust your gut and try dating him!” Encouraged by your pet chinchilla, you start a trial relationship on a hunch! Will he actually turn hot… or not!? A romantic comedy Otome game. Fully voiced (except for the protagonist).

hiddenGems.name: 500 FINGER FILLET
hiddenGems.shortDescription: 500 STABS. 20 MINUTES TO ESCAPE. A horror roguelite about stabbing yourself in the hand 500 times to escape a deadly trap. Can you make it out with all your fingers? Or will you bleed out on the table?
hiddenGems.shortDescriptionEn: 500 STABS. 20 MINUTES TO ESCAPE. A horror roguelite about stabbing yourself in the hand 500 times to escape a deadly trap. Can you make it out with all your fingers? Or will you bleed out on the table?

upcoming.name: Dirt Town
upcoming.shortDescription: Use incredible physics to create roads by pushing dirt, felling trees, moving rocks, hauling gravel. Dig a pit for resources, build a race track for the dirt bike! Get paid and buy more machines. Multiplayer for up to four players
upcoming.shortDescriptionEn: Use incredible physics to create roads by pushing dirt, felling trees, moving rocks, hauling gravel. Dig a pit for resources, build a race track for the dirt bike! Get paid and buy more machines. Multiplayer for up to four players

upcoming.name: Drunken Goddess Reflux
upcoming.shortDescription: Juega a una ruleta rusa de chupitos con una diablilla que siente por ti un amor de los que matan. Se trata de un juego de supervivencia donde o provocas que ella vomite su alma o será la tuya la que potes. Cuanto más bebas, más reglas podrás saltarte... te lo pasarás de muerte.
upcoming.shortDescriptionEn: Face off in a Russian roulette drinking survival with a demon who'd kill for you—or kill you—where it's puke or be puked on for your soul. The more you drink, the more the rules break down, until it all spills into one hell of a night you'll never forget.

upcoming.name: Reshine
upcoming.shortDescription: Restaura antigüedades limpiando las capas de polvo, óxido y el paso del tiempo. Reshine es una experiencia minimalista y relajante. Usa herramientas para ver cómo años de suciedad desaparecen ante tus ojos. Sin complicaciones, sin presión, solo la satisfacción de devolver vida a tesoros vintage.
upcoming.shortDescriptionEn: Gently restore old objects by cleaning away layers of dust, rust, and time. Reshine is a minimalistic, relaxing experience: use a range of tools to watch years of grime disappear before your eyes. No management, no pressure - just you and the satisfaction of bringing vintage treasures back to life.

upcoming.name: Shark Mart
upcoming.shortDescription: Shark Mart es un simulador cooperativo loco sobre tiburones infiltrados disfrazados de delfines amigables. Gestiona la tienda, limpia ballenas y secuestra peces desprevenidos para cocinar deliciosos platos. ¡Pero cuidado! La Policía de los Peces quiere descubrir vuestro secreto dentado...
upcoming.shortDescriptionEn: Shark Mart is a crazy co-op simulator about sharks undercover disguised as friendly dolphins. Run the shop, and scrub whales to secretly kidnap unsuspecting fish and cook up tasty delicacies! But beware - the Fish Police are out to expose your toothy secret...

upcoming.name: TROLLHEIM: GNOMES
upcoming.shortDescription: Ponte en la piel de un gnomo y explora un bosque vivo en esta aventura de supervivencia PVE y multijugador inspirada en el folclore nórdico. Recolecta recursos, fabrica y construye un hogar para tu familia de gnomos en los árboles y conoce a los Väsen. Juega en solitario o con hasta 8 jugadores.
upcoming.shortDescriptionEn: Explore an ancient, living forest as a tiny gnome in this co-op PVE survival crafting adventure inspired by Nordic folklore. Gather, craft and build a home for your gnome family amongst the treetops, and encounter the Väsen, mythical beings both friendly and dangerous. Play solo or up to 8 players

upcoming.name: Lost Bitcoin
upcoming.shortDescription: Lost Bitcoin es un juego de excavación y automatización en una gigantesca chatarrería. Recoge chatarra, quémala para conseguir monedas, compra mejoras y construye una fábrica que trabaje para ti. Abre cajas y cajas fuertes, y revisa cada memoria USB para encontrar tu monedero de Bitcoin perdido.
upcoming.shortDescriptionEn: Lost Bitcoin is a digging and automation game set in a gigantic junkyard. Collect scrap, burn it for coins, buy upgrades and build a factory that works for you. Crack crates and safes, and check every USB stick to find your lost Bitcoin wallet.

upcoming.name: No Mercy
upcoming.shortDescription: Un crudo shooter en primera persona de estilo Bodycam donde un golpe de Estado fallido sume la ciudad en el caos. Ábrete paso por calles controladas por bandas, descubre la verdad sobre la desaparición de tu esposa y recupera lo que te arrebataron, bala a bala.
upcoming.shortDescriptionEn: A gritty bodycam-style first-person shooter where a failed coup throws the city into chaos. Fight through gang-controlled streets, uncover the truth behind your wife's disappearance, and take back what was stolen—one bullet at a time.

upcoming.name: GrimKeep
upcoming.shortDescription: GrimKeep es un roguelite de composición de dados inspirado en un cuento de hadas de pesadilla. Encuentra objetos, tira los dados y optimiza tu build para desatar un daño brutal. Ábrete paso entre los horrores de la ciudad maldita hasta llegar a la Princesa. Y luego acaba con ella.
upcoming.shortDescriptionEn: GrimKeep is a roguelite dice-builder in a nightmare fairytale. Find items, roll your dice, and optimize your build to fire off massive damage. Cut through the horrors in the cursed city to get to the Princess. Then end her.

upcoming.name: Split Brain Samsara
upcoming.shortDescription: Tu amigo y tú están atrapados en el mismo cuerpo. En esta aventura cooperativa, aprende a controlar el mismo personaje, aventúrate en el plano espiritual y revela la conspiración de la megaestructura Samsara. ¡La comunicación es la clave!
upcoming.shortDescriptionEn: You and your friend are locked in the same body! In this co-op adventure, learn to control the same character, venture into your spiritual realm, and unravel the machinations of the Samsara megastructure! Communication will be key!

upcoming.name: Dear Passengers
upcoming.shortDescription: Juega en cooperativo como la tripulación de la peor aerolínea del mundo. Tu avión se cae a pedazos, tu carga es ilegal, y la seguridad de los pasajeros apenas entra en la lista de prioridades.
upcoming.shortDescriptionEn: Play in co-op as the crew of the world’s worst airline. Your plane is falling apart, your cargo is illegal, and passenger safety barely makes the list.

upcoming.name: Book Nook
upcoming.shortDescription: Construye dioramas en miniatura, pieza a pieza. Coloca muebles, decoraciones y pequeños detalles hasta completar cada rincón. Relájate, disfruta de ver cada pieza encajar y descubre la historia que esconde cada Book Nook.
upcoming.shortDescriptionEn: Build miniature diorama scenes, piece by piece. Complete beautiful book nooks as you place furniture, decorations, and small details. Relax and enjoy the peaceful satisfaction of every detail falling into place, as you discover more about each moment in time.

upcoming.name: DungeonBox
upcoming.shortDescription: Un juego de fiesta de fantasía para hasta 8 jugadores, en el que todos participan desde su móvil. ¡Escribe lo que quieres hacer, vota la mejor idea y tira los dados para ver si sale bien!
upcoming.shortDescriptionEn: A fantasy party game for up to 8 players, where everyone joins in from their phones. Type what you want to do, vote for the best idea, and roll dice to see if it works!

upcoming.name: Starship Crafter
upcoming.shortDescription: Asume el papel de un mecánico de naves estelares y salda la inmensa deuda que dejó tu padre. Fabrica componentes, construye naves estelares y acepta contratos de facciones. Sigue los eventos a través de la galaxia y paga la deuda antes de la fecha límite.
upcoming.shortDescriptionEn: Take on the role of a starship mechanic and pay off the immense debt your father left behind. Craft components, build starships, and take contracts from factions. Follow galactic events, and pay the debt before the deadline.

upcoming.name: Auto Mechanic Tidy Up
upcoming.shortDescription: ¡Pon en orden el taller mecánico! Clasifica las herramientas y las piezas de repuesto, coloca cada cosa en su sitio, limpia la suciedad y monta un coche pieza a pieza.
upcoming.shortDescriptionEn: Tidy up the auto repair shop! Sort the tools and spare parts, put everything in its place, clean off the dirt, and build a car piece by piece!

upcoming.name: Chronocracy
upcoming.shortDescription: ¡Construye una civilización única en un mundo plano! Explora, extrae recursos, expándete y combate enemigos. Usa tus habilidades de gestión del tiempo para defenderte de los ataques y acaba con una amenaza misteriosa. ¿Podrás crear un mundo capaz de sobrevivir?
upcoming.shortDescriptionEn: Build a unique civilization in a flat world! Explore, extract resources, expand, and battle enemies. Use your time management skills to fend off attacks and face a mysterious threat. Are you ready to create a world that can survive?

upcoming.name: Unharvest
upcoming.shortDescription: Drena la vida de todo lo que te rodea en este juego incremental de agricultura a la inversa. Infecta todo lo que crece, mejora tus plagas y marchita el mundo hasta que no quede nada vivo.
upcoming.shortDescriptionEn: Drain the life from everything around you in this reverse-farming incremental game. Infect all that grows, upgrade your plagues, and wither the world until nothing living remains.

upcoming.name: Family Time
upcoming.shortDescription: Build a family of thousands of wolf children with your own wolf partner!
upcoming.shortDescriptionEn: Build a family of thousands of wolf children with your own wolf partner!

upcoming.name: Figure Drawing Garden
upcoming.shortDescription: Coge tu cuaderno de bocetos, relájate, explora y dibuja en tu propio Figure Drawing Garden: un jardín virtual inmersivo diseñado para que practiques y mejores el dibujo de la figura humana.
upcoming.shortDescriptionEn: Grab your sketchbook, relax, explore, and draw in your very own Figure Drawing Garden - an immersive virtual garden designed for you to practice and improve at figure drawing.

upcoming.name: Bio Inc. Total Defense
upcoming.shortDescription: Bio Inc. Total Defense es un tower defense incremental ambientado dentro de tu cuerpo. Dirige tu sistema inmunitario contra hordas masivas de virus, bacterias y otros patógenos. Mejora tus defensas, colócalas con astucia y lucha por cada centímetro de tu cuerpo.
upcoming.shortDescriptionEn: Bio Inc. Total Defense is an incremental tower defense game set inside your body. Command your immune system against massive hordes of viruses, bacteria, and other pathogens. Upgrade your defenses, place them wisely, and fight for every inch of your body.

upcoming.name: Appulse
upcoming.shortDescription: Un intenso «roguelite» de disparos cenital con mecánicas de «pinball». Domina tu arma, usa el retroceso para controlar la bola y protege a la nave nodriza de los robots invasores. ¡Mejora tu equipo y tus habilidades para ganar la guerra!
upcoming.shortDescriptionEn: A thrilling top-down shooter inspired by pinball mechanics. Master your weapon and use the recoil to control your ball, while protecting your mothership from waves of invading robots. Upgrade your equipment, polish your skills, and win the war!
